items.title: IDRIS
items.why: Real national GPU supercomputer (CPU, V100, A100 and H100 partitions) operated with Slurm, a Lustre parallel file system and InfiniBand/Omni-Path networks: the closest public, documented example of the cluster stack a compute infrastructure engineer runs. The hardware, scheduler and filesystem pages are public documentation to read and reproduce in labs.

evidence.quote: L'environnement d'exploitation se base sur RedHat 9.6 (depuis le 17/02/2026) et Slurm 23.11.3 (depuis le 01/10/2024)

items.title: IDRIS training catalogue

Registration site was under maintenance on the page read, so check dates.

evidence.quote: L'IDRIS propose des formations en calcul haute performance (HPC) et en intelligence artificielle (IA)
